name: explore_and_orient
definition: Build situational understanding of the repo/issue before acting.

name: reproduce_failure
definition: Trigger and characterize the reported bug to establish a checkable failure.

name: localize_and_fix
definition: Find the root cause and edit source until the reproduction passes (edit↔verify loop).

name: add_regression_test
definition: Write and run a test that guards the fixed behavior.

name: setup_environment
definition: Install/configure dependencies needed to run the code or tests.

name: verify_and_submit
definition: Run the full suite, clean up scratch, and submit the patch.
